has content transfer encoding

  • CURIE: gmeow:hasContentTransferEncoding
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasContentTransferEncoding
  • Category: property

Relates a body part to its Content-Transfer-Encoding value (base64, quoted-printable, 7bit, 8bit, binary).

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:BodyPart -> gmeow:ContentTransferEncoding; functional
